result: A completed glTF or OBJ reading draws its accepted result in the file's own frame in the reading panel: flat-lit, orbitable, display only, with axes and units as the reading states them.

inputs.good: test_only unit cube in the shape the Box.glb reading states (E:/BhuAayam-data/task-data/desktop-gltf-native/final-glb/gltf.json, read only: 2 nodes, 1 primitive, 24 positions, 36 indices); test_only OBJ artifact with two four-corner faces
inputs.difficult: test_only pin mismatch (SHA-256 differs), an index past POSITION, a non-object result, a reading stating 60,000 positions, an OBJ face the reader did not project, a DXF and a running reading
inputs.realFiles: No runtime exercised. The Box.glb artifact shape (field names, qualification.localFrame) was read from the task-data file; the OBJ shape from desktop-obj-native/complete-run01/obj.json.

acceptance: The Box-shaped glTF result is fetched once through the typed api-client from .../gltf/jobs/{jobId}/native, its size and SHA-256 checked against the reading's artifact pins, and drawn as 12 triangles from 24 stored positions

Own-frame words: drawn in the file's own frame, centred in the view, not placed on the map, nothing converted, placed or measured, display only; axes Right handed Y up and unit Metre as the reading states; node transforms not applied
An OBJ result with two faces gives two polygons; axes and units Unknown as the reading states; faces of more than three corners are filled as fans for display only and the stored faces are unchanged
A pin mismatch shows 'The model could not be read from the accepted result: its bytes differ from the size and SHA-256 the reading states.' and no drawing
A malformed result shows 'The accepted result is not in the shape its reader writes, so no preview is drawn.'; a reading past the cap shows words and is never fetched
Vertex cap: MODEL_PREVIEW_MAX_POSITIONS = 50,000 stored positions, stated in words when a reading exceeds it
The preview disposes its geometry, materials, controls, renderer, resize observer and canvas on unmount; a browser without WebGL gets words
decisions: Stored values are drawn as they are; the view is centred on the model's bounds for display only, so large source coordinates keep float precision. The second value (y) is drawn as up and the panel says this sets the view only.
glTF: only primitives the reader marked available_local_projection with mode 4 (triangle list) are drawn; others are counted as not drawn. Node transforms stay declarations, as the reading states.
OBJ: only faces with projectionEligible true are drawn, by resolved vertex index; only referenced vertices count toward the cap.
The pin check follows useIfcStructure readNative (size, SHA-256, strict UTF-8 JSON); the IFC file was not edited.
No contract, API, reader, OpenAPI or CSS file changed. The preview container is sized inline with --ui-* tokens.
